description: Parse a raw email header block (e.g. Gmail's "Show original", or the headers from a .eml file) into structured fields, the Received hop chain in the order they appear, and any SPF/DKIM/DMARC verdicts already present in an Authentication-Results header. Never performs a live DNS/SPF/DKIM check, it only reports what the pasted headers already claim.
name: analyze_email_headers
